notes: Fresh offline installations of both identified development ISOs; booted without installer media.
No packages added, removed or upgraded; no apt update; no application windows opened before measurement.
Default desktop services, a second virtual-console shell, serial-console shell/getty and Python sampler included identically in both.
120-second settle followed by five samples 10 seconds apart; median reported.
Disk is root plus EFI used filesystem blocks, excluding swap; swap report from /proc/swaps is in KiB.
Virtual display uses software rendering; physical GPU, driver, RAM capacity and hardware services can change idle RAM.
X11 development image is preserved; this baseline is not the older published Alpha 2 image.

release.note: Alpha 3 is the measured Wayland candidate with only /etc/erdos-release relabeled; raw candidate measurements and image identity are retained.
